name: Vyapar Books PRO
releaseNotes: Cash & Bank now has a read-only Reconcile report that explains each account’s opening balance, inflows, outflows, and closing balance
Negative balances are identified as real ledger positions, with source breakdowns and clear warnings instead of implying a calculation error
The audit flags unconfigured account IDs and candidate duplicate outflows for manual review; it never posts adjustments or writes data
Reconciliation exports as an audit-friendly CSV with account, source, and duplicate-candidate sections
PWA updater now selects the exact tarball asset URL instead of also matching its checksum asset
No tax, invoice numbering, conflict, or existing business data was changed in this update
